conditions: The target is an existing valid resizable array variable, the statement has Preserve, and no independent error intervenes.
limitations: The applicability is MS-VBAL revision 2.4, dated May 20, 2025. Specific Office application behavior, earlier and later revisions, and other Visual Basic lineages require separate evidence.
The restriction does not cover a previously unmatched name interpreted as a declaration, a ByRef-locked variable, default lower-bound rules, or preservation of physical memory layout.

triggers: Publisher correction, digest mismatch, a revised language edition, or contrary clause evidence.

statement: When ReDim Preserve resizes an existing VBA array, only the upper bound of the last dimension can change. Changing the rank, a lower bound, or an earlier upper bound raises runtime error 9.
